metadata.description: Screen candidate B: whiten versus truncate the target-restricted pullback sensitivity operator of a three-phase unbalanced LV feeder.

screen_B.mechanism_one_line: partial whitening of the target-restricted sensitivity operator re-weights its near-null directions, while rank truncation discards them

protocol.reserved_note: Reserving seeds reserves SPLITS, not data: every fold draws from the same 220-row pool, so the genuinely untouched evidence is the 2.6x regime and the moved-phase feeder.
protocol.denominator: mean per-output standard deviation of the TRAINING rows of each fold (leak-free); the all-row denominator is reported beside it for the LinDistFlow row so the change from the archived tables is quantified
protocol.baseline_primary: per-output ridge with an unpenalised intercept on a logspace(-8,3,12) trace-relative grid chosen by train-only CV on multiphase LinDistFlow
protocol.margin_reference: minimum over b1a, b2, b3, b4 and b5-primary, per fold
protocol.reused_ensembles: archived 220-draw runpp_3ph pools at the 2.0x regime, never re-solved on the measurement path

gp_hyperparameters.convention: one shared triple per arm and fold, chosen by marginal likelihood over all 45 outputs

structural_facts.condition_number_note: cond(S) is NOT a reproducible number for this operator. S is rank deficient (29 of 45 singular values sit above the double-precision floor, so the last sixteen are pure round-off), therefore cond(S) is the reciprocal of a round-off residue. The same matrix gives 4.99e+32 through numpy.linalg.svd(S, compute_uv=False) and 1.13e+16 through numpy.linalg.svd(S, full_matrices=False) - different LAPACK paths, elementwise identical input. The archived record quotes 1.28873e+32. The reproducible statements are the effective ranks at 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4, the stable rank, and condition_number_at_rank23 which is the condition number of the numerically nonsingular core.
structural_facts.admittance_spectrum_method: scipy.linalg.eigvals on the full grounded block Laplacian (general, non-Hermitian)

corrections_to_prior_text: whitening exponent

The direction text writes S_gamma = U diag((sigma/sigma_1)^gamma) Vt and calls gamma=0 the raw operator. That is inverted: at gamma=0 it yields U Vt, the fully whitened semi-orthogonal map, and at gamma=1 the raw operator. This artifact implements the ratio form w_i = (sigma_i/sigma_0)^(1-gamma) used by the working pilot code, and asserts the orientation before any modelling.
gamma-0 assertion is impossible as written

STEP 3 asserts Phi_{45,0}(x) == S x / sigma_0 elementwise. The ratio form drops the left singular vector U, an orthogonal rotation that leaves every RBF kernel bit-identical, so the assertion is implemented as U @ Phi_{45,0}(x) == S x/sigma_0 to 1e-10 plus equality of the squared-distance matrices. Measured deviation is recorded in results/protocol_checks.json.
LinDistFlow baseline recalibrated

The archived p17 joint-map calibration (one 46-column trace-scaled ridge penalising the intercept, CV grid floor 1e-4 reached in 20/20 seeds) is replaced as the margin reference by per-output ridge with an unpenalised intercept on a logspace(-8,3,12) trace-relative grid. The p17 calibration is retained as a labelled secondary row so this table maps onto the earlier one.
normalisation denominator

The archived p17 and final_table tables divided by the ALL-ROW per-output sd, leaking test-set spread into the metric. This artifact divides by the TRAINING rows of each fold, so it will not reproduce p17 to the digit even where the model is identical; both denominators are reported for the LinDistFlow row at every n.
RBF lengthscale grid

The archived RBF arms searched lengthscales up to 8 while squared distances in 110 standardised dimensions are near 220, making exp(-220/128)=0.18 an almost constant kernel. Both a median-normalised (primary) and the raw-scale (secondary) form are reported so the archived 'RBF sits at the mean predictor' claim can be re-read.
admittance competitor dimensionality

probe12 measured the admittance-Laplacian competitor at 55 dimensions against a 110-dimensional treatment. Here it is built at 110 dimensions: a real feature map taking the real and imaginary parts of the own-phase voltage drop Z_l @ s.
fold count

12 seeds x 2 schemes gives 24 folds at n<=80 and 12 at n=160, i.e. 108 fold-cells, not the 20 seeds x 3 schemes (60 folds) of the earlier direction and not the 30 folds per cell claimed in earlier text. Scheme 1 cannot draw 160 rows from a 110-row half, so that cell is skipped by construction. Every results cell carries its own fold count.
seeds reserve splits, not data

Seeds 12 to 29 are reserved and were not evaluated. Reserving seeds reserves SPLITS, not data: the same 220 draws underlie every fold. The genuinely untouched evidence is the 2.6x regime and the moved-phase feeder.
selection-optimism row added

A per-fold oracle (best of 64 variants chosen on TEST error) is reported beside the train-selected arm, so a train-CV-selected grid cannot be confused with grid-shopping. Reported as selection_optimism_at_80.
shuffled-phase control scope

This artifact carries only the cheap consistency form of the shuffled-phase control - the selected whitening re-run with the operator's load-to-phase assignment permuted while the data stay on real phases. It is not the physically-moved-phase control, which the direction reserves for the survivor, so this artifact can say nothing about phase identity.
supervision beyond the spec

A6_floor reports the pre-registered floor 1e-3 (the rank-19 point) as its single row, with the family mean carried alongside; selecting the best floor on test error would be exactly the grid-shopping the oracle row exists to bound.
RBF mean-predictor claim re-tested, not restated

The archived claim that an isotropic RBF on injections sits at the mean predictor is re-tested by comparing the median-normalised form (b1a, primary) against the raw 110-dim scale (b1b, what the archived arms used) at every n. The measured gap is recorded in per_n[n].baselines.rbf_median_normalisation_gain.
GP hyperparameter criterion

The archived p17 / p8_full / pilot GP scored -0.5||K^-1 Yc||_F^2 - 0.5 m log|K|, the squared norm of the solved coefficients, which is not the marginal likelihood (-0.5 tr(Yc^T K^-1 Yc) - 0.5 m log|K|). This artifact keeps the archived criterion so its arms are comparable with the earlier tables, and verifies it against a dense reference in test_gp.py; both criteria are implemented in gp_corr and the correct one is available as mll_mode='quadratic'.
shuffled-phase operator construction

STEP 3 of the plan writes default_rng(31).permutation(55) 'applied to the 55 load phases', which if applied to the label array yields integers 0..54 that are not phase indices and raises IndexError inside build_S. The executable control - the one the archived p8_full shufLab arm built - is phase_shuffled = phase_true[perm], a permutation of which load carries which phase. Implemented that way and recorded in protocol_checks.json.
jitter sweep interpretation

The jitter sweep ADDS j to the selected noise level rather than replacing it, and includes j=0 as the selected-fit reference row. Replacing the noise with j tests a different model, not the numerical stability of the selected one; a first implementation did that and produced guard-g1 failures (normalised RMSE 1.7e2 against a mean predictor of 1.2 on n=40 fold 4000) that were numerical artefacts.
cond(S) is a round-off residue, not a reproducible number

S is rank deficient (29 of 45 singular values above the double-precision floor), so cond(S) is the reciprocal of a round-off residue: 4.99e+32 through one LAPACK path and 1.13e+16 through another, on elementwise identical input, against the archived 1.28873e+32. The reproducible statements are the effective ranks at 1e-2/1e-3/1e-4, the stable rank 2.1768, and cond over the rank-23 core (2230). Reported in structural_facts.json with this note attached.
tempered-noise diagnostic added

The direction rests confidence on coverage, so a tempered-noise row (A10) is reported beside every Gaussian-process arm: the marginal-likelihood mean with the predictive variance fixed at the TRAIN empirical residual variance. If A10's coverage is near nominal while A1's is not, the coverage deficit is a noise-inference artefact rather than a property of the metric.

exponent_orientation.note: STEP 3 asserts Phi_{45,0}(x) == S x / sv0 elementwise. That is impossible: the ratio form drops the left singular vector U, an orthogonal rotation that leaves every RBF kernel bit-identical. The assertion is therefore implemented as (a) U @ Phi_{45,0}(x) == S x / sv0 to 1e-10 and (b) the squared-distance matrices agreeing. Recorded as a correction.

shuffled_phase_operator.construction: phase_shuffled = phase_true[perm] with perm = default_rng(31).permutation(55); the operator's load-to-phase assignment is permuted while the data stay on the real phases

cyclic_relabel_null_control.construction: phase_true + 1 mod 3 (global cyclic relabel, a symmetry)

protocol_checks.reused_ensembles: archived 220-draw runpp_3ph pools from iter_2/gen_hypo/claude_agent/pilot (ens_s2.0_X.npy, ens_s2.0_Y.npy); zero AC solves on the measurement path

T4_baseline_order.note: probe8.log recorded 0.1665 honest against 0.3805 for the archived joint-map calibration at n=10 on the p17 fold family. This artifact uses the shared screen fold family (seed base 20261111, not p17's 31337), so the levels are close but not identical. The ordering is the invariant that matters.
